acceptance: aipo-runtime exposes ModuleGraph with a deterministic topological initialization order (dependencies before dependents, lexicographic canonical-path tie-break), acyclic verification surfaced as AIPO_SEM_IMPORT_CYCLE, missing dependencies as AIPO_SEM_UNKNOWN_MODULE, and a NativeRegistry catalog of Prelude and built-in module functions

aipo-stdlib::register_stdlib installs Prelude V1 (values none/true/false; functions len/copy/same/some/fail; explicit conversions Int/Float/Byte/String) and the math, string and io module dictionaries into both the VM globals and the NativeRegistry metadata
Every cataloged native function returns Result and no Rust panic escapes as an Aipo error: domain problems produce recoverable Failure values (Model B) while programming violations produce VmFault

Canon argument rules are enforced and covered by tests: split and replace reject empty patterns, join rejects non-String elements without implicit coercion, round halves away from zero, reverse preserves extended grapheme clusters and re-normalizes its result to NFC, and Int/Float/Byte/String conversions follow the documented Failure-vs-fault split

docs/stdlib/mvp-subset.md documents the implemented closed surface and docs/adp/ADP-001-byte-and-core-types-as-values.md records the Byte/Bytes/first-class-type representation gaps instead of inventing semantics
cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets, cargo test --workspace and cargo doc --workspace --no-deps are all green
